# DA

##  Raw counts

```{r raw_counts, fig.height=3}
raw_counts_summary = read.table(paste0(prefix, "_count.txt.summary"), header=TRUE, row.names=1)
colnames(raw_counts_summary) = sub(paste0(".*", gse, "\\.([^.]+)_end\\.to\\.end.*"), "\\1", colnames(raw_counts_summary))
raw_counts_summary = raw_counts_summary[!apply(raw_counts_summary==0, 1, all),]
layout(matrix(1:3, 1), respect=TRUE)
cols = c(
  "#E63946",  # rouge
  "#F4A261",  # orange
  "#E9C46A",  # jaune
  "#2A9D8F",  # vert/bleu
  "#457B9D",  # bleu
  "#6D597A",  # violet
  "#B56576",  # vieux rose
  "#588157"   # vert
)
barplot(col=cols, as.matrix(raw_counts_summary), las=2)
barplot(col=cols, prop.table(as.matrix(raw_counts_summary), margin=2), las=2)
plot.new()
legend("topleft", legend=rownames(raw_counts_summary), fill=cols, bty="n")

raw_counts = read.table(paste0(prefix, "_count.txt"), header=TRUE)
rownames(raw_counts) = raw_counts[,1]
pf = raw_counts[,1:6]
raw_counts = as.matrix(raw_counts[,-(1:6)])
colnames(raw_counts) = sub(paste0(".*", gse, "\\.([^.]+)_end\\.to\\.end.*"), "\\1", colnames(raw_counts))
head(raw_counts[,1:3])
tail(raw_counts[,1:3])
dim( raw_counts)

```


## Filtering features

```{r density, results="verbatim"}
layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)
plot(density(log2(raw_counts)+1))
# raw_counts = raw_counts[!apply(raw_counts<2048, 1, all),]
raw_counts = raw_counts[!apply(raw_counts<32, 1, all),]
plot(density(log2(raw_counts)+1))
dim(raw_counts)
```



# Volcano plots


```{r volcano, results="verbatim"}

if (!all(e$gsm %in% colnames(raw_counts))) {stop("problem gsm vs. colnames(raw_counts)")}
countData = raw_counts[,e$gsm]
colnames(countData) = rownames(e)
colData = e[colnames(countData),]
# Vérifie que les noms de colonnes correspondent
if (!all(colnames(countData) == rownames(colData))) {stop("probleme data vs. e")}


for (k in factoi) {
  # k = "sprayed_status"
  print(k)
  model_formula = paste0("~", k)
  frmula = formula(model_formula)

  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = countData[,rownames(colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),])],
    colData = colData[!is.na(colData[,k]),],
    design = frmula
  )
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  res <- DESeq2::results(dds)

  head(res[is.na(res$pvalue),])
  sum(!is.na(res$pvalue))
  sum(is.na(res$pvalue))
  sum(!is.na(res$padj))
  res = res[!is.na(res$pvalue),]
  # res = res[!is.na(res$padj),]

  layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
  plot(res$log2FoldChange, -log10(res$pvalue), xlab="l2fc", ylab="-log10(pval)", main=frmula)
  plot(res$log2FoldChange, -log10(res$padj)  , xlab="l2fc", ylab="-log10(padj)", main=frmula)

  # res = res[order(res$log2FoldChange), ]
  idx = rownames(res)[!is.na(res$padj)&res$padj< 0.05]
  print(cbind(pf[idx,2:4], res[idx, c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj") ]))

  model_func_name = "deseq2"  
  prefix3 = paste0(gse, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula)

  tmp_df = cbind(pf[rownames(res),], res)
  head(tmp_df)
  # WriteXLS::WriteXLS(tmp_df, paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".xlsx"))

  # gsea_input = cbind(rownames(tmp_df), tmp_df$log2FoldChange)
  # head(gsea_input)
  # dim(gsea_input)
  # gsea_input_filename = paste0("results_", prefix3, "_", prefix2, "_", prefix, ".rnk")
  # write.table(gsea_input, gsea_input_filename, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

  bed = tmp_df[,-1]
  head(bed)
  bed[,3] = bed[,2]+1
  bed[,4] = rownames(bed)
  bed[,5] = bed$pvalue
  bed[,6] = "+"
  bed[,7] = bed$log2FoldChange
  bed[,8] = -log10(bed[,5])  
  bed = bed[,1:8]
  colnames(bed) = c("#chrom", "start", "end", "probes", "pval", "strand", "l2fc", "lpv")
  head(bed)
  dim(bed)

  # write ewas res for combp
  bed[,1] = as.character(bed[,1])
  bed = bed[order(bed[,1], bed[,2]),]
  bed_ewas_filename = paste0("ewas4combp_", prefix3, ".bed")
  write.table(bed, file=bed_ewas_filename , sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
  # bed_on_disk = read.table(bed_ewas_filename, sep="\t", header=TRUE)



}
```
